candidate: Keep the 120 ms anchoring, 80 ms step, two-band 0.62 correlation and ranked 12 coarse candidates from the previous local-lag study. A fine lag survives only if its full 16 kHz position still passes 0.62 in two bands at an anchor that nominated its coarse lag, with the same band energy limit. If more than 12 distinct fine lags survive, abstain from the fallback instead of arbitrarily keeping a subset. Apply the unchanged native interval verifier to the survivors only after a whole-file search was assessed without a pair. No prior file, trained weights or labeled positions enter inference.
source_exposure: New exact clips from 48 kHz DEMAND channel pairs and separately recorded AMI Array1-05 microphones. The recording families were used in other checks, so this is a prospective excerpt holdout and not a corpus-blind validation. Primary room and replacement placements avoid overlaps with the documented short AAC, local-lag, timing, rate and native-alignment sample blocks for those scenes. TMETRO also avoids the documented stereo-difference development blocks. AMI starts exceed the 600-second prior stereo room sampling limit. Cover original speech at the selected starts without a post-result speech activity filter.
control_roster: For each of 24 matched room/foreground pairs, retain recorded, ordinary panned, different background, moving voice, repeated foreground, identical channels and a no-copy two-band motor/chime-like sweep under the ordinary panned foreground. Include all 30 separately recorded DCASE 2013 bus, tube and tubestation sources as both a 17-second-start continuous crop and a 24-second-start ordinary panned-voice overlay. Convert DCASE native 44.1 kHz PCM to 48 kHz once before the paired transcodes. Some DCASE source files appeared in prior stereo-difference work; the short transit excerpts and voice placements are new to lag scoring. Synthetic sweep controls are separate from real transit controls.
clock: Stage repeats at 10 and 18 dB nominal speech-to-room levels. Encode each role's exact PCM parent as paired 160 kb/s AAC and CBR stereo Ogg Opus. Opus must present 180000 samples at 48 kHz with 188 packets of 960 samples, 312 pre-skip and 168 trailing trim. Cross-check decoded native counts and a zero start for both encodings. Exact half-open source sample ranges and all input and PCM hashes are kept.
acceptance: Each true pair must overlap at least 0.50 interval IoU at both occurrences. Preserve all existing true baseline flags; gain at least three useful pairs from at least two source groups with at most two new ordinary flags and two new misplaced edited files. Require no new flag on the real transit crops and overlays, or on the periodic control. Release additionally requires at least 16 correct pairs of 48 across at least two environments and both loudness levels, and 85% or more paired retention of the useful AAC results. Report the experimental and release conditions individually. This checks repeated sound under speech and would carry zero AI-confidence weight.
